column1: # Where a translation numbers a paragraph otherwise than we do, as
# build/translation.py joins it to ours: every translation is mapped to our
# numbering, the press's, which the English uses (Tigran, 2026-10-26).
# Columns: the translation's key; its first and last address; our first and
# last.  "-" where its paragraph is none of ours: a separator it numbers.
# "title 0:12" is a section's title standing inside the section, after its
# first paragraphs, which is our heading paragraph there.  A run lies within
# one section, and every address not listed is ours.  The build requires
# exactly these: one that matches nothing is out of date, and fails.
# ud numbers ten of the press's eleven separators, as the study edition did
# until 2026-09-21 (8af25c5): 31:10.22 as \separatorline, the other nine as
# empty paragraphs.  Everything after one, in its section, is one ahead.
# Its Acknowledgment's heading is a \usection, БЛАГОДАРНОСТЬ, which ud.sty's
# urantia-ru numbers 144:5 as the Urantia Foundation does (tests/known-uf-refs.tsv):
# a number skipped at each of the six separators between the prayers.
# Its Acknowledgment's heading is a \usection, «Заключительные замечания»,
# which urantia-ru.sty's \ackn names as the Acknowledgment's: our 0:12.10.
